short_description: JunoCam wide-angle camera filters on Juno at Jupiter

licence.scope: NASA science data licence (NASA-led mission data), as followed for Cassini__ISS_NAC and Aqua__MODIS. The JunoCam mission page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/junocam) carries no terms of its own and its footer 'Legal' link leads to NASA's site policy; the page SVO cites is the Hansen et al. 2014 JunoCam paper PDF (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/pub/e/downloads/JunoCam_Junos_Outreach_Camera.pdf). The licence covers NASA-led mission data; whether the curve file is marked otherwise was not seen. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material.
